What date format should I use for the NGB-datepicker

\r\n

The format is described here but just to reiterate,\r\n the datepicker placeholder format should be dd-mon-yyyy and the rendered\r\n date format that\r\n then appears in the UI should be unhyphenated and capitalized, for example 01 Jan\r\n 2021

\r\n

Questions about Design Language components

\r\n

Where can I find the markup for a given component?

\r\n

Most if not all of our components listed in the left menu from Animations to Widgets\r\n have an\r\n accompanying gist file that can be accessed by opening the right side View\r\n gist blade\r\n

\r\n
\r\n\r\n
\r\n

Can we use custom css in our projects?

\r\n

No, please do not use custom css! This is for a very\r\n good reason. All of our components have accompanying SASS files that are designed specifically for our Apps\r\n to work\r\n correctly with Flex and dark-mode. If you really need to tweak things, you can use\r\n our collection of\r\n helpers/modifiers that are listed under the Modifiers section in the\r\n left navigation. Have a play around,\r\n you can actually build the foundations of a component just using these alone, here's one below\r\n

\r\n \r\n

This was created using the Modifiers only, found in the left navigation

\r\n

Hello there. Check dev-tools to see how you can create stuff just by just using the\r\n Modifiers
