Filter left

\r\n
\r\n

Filter left can be useful when we need to display the page in two columns, \r\n it also reducuces vertical page scrolling. Place this filter inside your 'content-container' adding the \r\n class names 'padding-left-0 flex-group flex-start'. This will push the filter over to the left side so there is no left spacing \r\n on the page whilst also setting up your container to display it's contents horizontally using flex. You're right side content \r\n will need to be wrapped in some container. You'll need to set the filter to be a lot narrower than your right-side content, to \r\n do this use a flex value on each, for example 'flex-1' for the filter and 'flex-5' for the right-side content. \r\n See the Flex section for more details.\r\n
