If you would like to use an accordion in your blade. Just add the \r\n standard accordion like you would \r\n normally. For nested accordions, you will still need the boolean \r\n [iconsEnabled] but you won't need to add the iconName or iconBgColor\r\n as these are modified in css.\r\n

Standard blade

\r\n

\r\n Please refer to the gist file. You have to make sure that the aa-tab-navigation component \r\n sits just above the blade-content wrapper. Then ensure that your router-outlet sits \r\n inside the blade-content wrapper. \r\n

\r\n

Custom blade

\r\n

\r\n If adding tabs to the custom-blade, you will need to add an ng-container with the select name \r\n custom-blade-tabs just inside your custom-header and below your content for the custom-header. \r\n Then add your router-outlet inside the custom-content ng-container wrapper. Again please refer \r\n to the custom-blade gist file.\r\n
