Date-picker

\r\n
\r\n

For date-pickers, use the \r\n NGB datepicker \r\n along with our markup which is styled specifically to match our branding. The date-picker placeholder\r\n format should be dd-mon-yyyy and the rendered date format that then appears in the UI should be unhyphenated and capitalized, for\r\n example 01 Jan 2021\r\n
