Modal - component version

\r\n
\r\n

Modals should only be used to inform the user of a particular event and or decision.\r\n Please avoid using modals for complex form data/tables etc, for this please use one \r\n of the Design language blades.\r\n

\r\n

\r\n You can now set different colour themes for the modal. The available colours \r\n are: red, orange, green and blue. \r\n

\r\n
\r\n \r\n
\r\n If you want to set the modal over aa-blade, \r\n please set a rightPos and set lefPos to 'auto'
