Custom button

\r\n
\r\n

In curtain circumstances, if an existing button is not available you
\r\n might want to create your own. To do this use the below tool to preview
\r\n one of the Material Icons and then choose your background colour.
\r\n If you do not want to display the button label, add .label-transparent to\r\n the parent div.field element. DO NOT remove the label as this maintains the\r\n vertical alignment when alongside other form elements\r\n

aa-buttonfieldClassClass\r\n
\r\n .boxed, .label-hidden or .label-transparent?\r\n \r\n

Classes applied to fieldClass

\r\n

.boxed removes the top padding of the field wrapper.

\r\n

.label-hidden completely removes the label on the button which\r\n causes\r\n the button to move up and out of alignment with other inputs that have labels.\r\n

\r\n

.label-transparent hides the label on the button whilst\r\n maintaining vertical\r\n alignment with other inputs that have labels. This is the preferred\r\n approach

\r\n \r\n
\r\n

\r\n Only use if there's a business requirement\r\n \r\n

Button large

\r\n

We prefer it if you stick with the standard buttons for consistency across the UI. The\r\n standard buttons also align correctly. Using the large version can cause alignment issues\r\n

\r\n

Icon buttons

\r\n
\r\n

If you want a button with just an icon and no text, you can simply use\r\n a button with the .material-icons class and the\r\n icon\r\n friendly name,\r\n also remember to include the relevant button class, .primary, .secondary etc.
\r\n If you do not want to display the button label, add .label-transparent to\r\n the parent div.field element. DO NOT remove the label as this maintains the\r\n vertical alignment when alongside other form elements\r\n

Standard buttons

\r\n
\r\n

There is an array of standard buttons available in
\r\n Design Language. For consistency, please try and use the
\r\n standard versions wherever possible.
\r\n If you do not want to display the button label, add .label-transparent to\r\n the parent div.field element. DO NOT remove the label as this maintains the\r\n vertical alignment when alongside other form elements\r\n

Button split

\r\n
\r\n

\r\n If you do not want to display the button label, add .label-transparent to\r\n the parent div.field element. DO NOT remove the label as this maintains the\r\n vertical alignment when alongside other form elements\r\n
